comment: Documented condition, but reached by the head check (jsntrs-qr9): /other-operators says "update - evaluates to an object that is merged into the object matched by each location", so `|$|5|` is ill-formed. This case never gets that far -- the head `5` fails the transformer's signature first, which is why the code is T0410 and not the T2011 the update clause raises. case027 covers the update clause itself.
